title: Build Seedance scenes by defining the character (who they are), their goal…
content:
Build Seedance scenes by defining the character (who they are), their goal (what they want), and the consequence (what changes after the moment) so each generated shot has a clear narrative purpose.  
Use Seedance 2.5 workflows in CapCut PC to generate and compare variations (different character, location, consequence) before committing to the final story path.  
Use CapCut’s AI Edit to change specific details in a shot while keeping the overall scene intact, iterating on what already works instead of regenerating everything.

Usa los flujos de trabajo de Seedance 2.5 en CapCut PC para generar y comparar variaciones (distinto personaje, ubicación, consecuencia) antes de comprometerte con la ruta final de la historia.  
Usa AI Edit de CapCut para cambiar detalles específicos en un plano manteniendo intacta la escena general, iterando sobre lo que ya funciona en lugar de regenerarlo todo.
